scope: Frame-styled React interfaces; validate against the selected released component and style set.
execution: Descriptive rules, not executable configuration or an installed checker.
sourceMapping: Constraint IDs map to the 11 implementation constraints in the public AI implementation guide; principle IDs map to the public Frame design principles.
severityMeaning: Requirement severity is distinct from automation: advisory emits warnings, human-only has no machine enforcement, partial-error catches selected patterns only.

rules.title: Token colors
rules.requirement: Use semantic token classes for UI colors.
rules.checks: Selected bracket-hex, palette and same-line inline style literals.
rules.cannotCheck: Computed values, alternate syntax, contrast and token existence.

rules.title: Typography
rules.checks: Selected px text/leading and native type/weight classes.
rules.cannotCheck: Other units, dynamic classes, CSS overrides and installed style availability.
rules.humanReview: Inspect readable hierarchy at each viewport.

rules.title: Token alpha
rules.requirement: Choose an explicit semantic token instead of numeric slash alpha.
rules.checks: Numeric slash alpha on fixed Frame token-family prefixes.
rules.cannotCheck: Arbitrary alpha syntax, new prefixes and actual generated CSS.
rules.humanReview: Inspect intended opacity and contrast in both themes.

rules.title: Surface separation
rules.requirement: Use fill or border on a card/panel; dashed placeholders may use both.
rules.cannotCheck: Surface semantics, nested layers and visual hierarchy.
rules.humanReview: Decide whether a dashed border communicates a placeholder.

rules.title: Shared composition
rules.requirement: Reuse and compose released primitives before creating shared extensions.
rules.cannotCheck: Component availability, duplicated behavior and dependency closure.

examples.nonconforming: Copy the StatusTag implementation into each page

rules.humanReview: Review the consumer shared module and extension contract.

rules.title: UI icons
rules.requirement: Use lucide-react for chrome; do not use emoji, letters or inline SVG as icon substitutes.
rules.checks: Selected emoji codepoints/escapes/entities with comment heuristics in current scoped files.
rules.cannotCheck: Other libraries, inline SVG, letter substitutes, generated-message semantics and all Unicode emoji sequences.
rules.humanReview: Separate UI chrome from generated message copy; review semantic exceptions.

rules.title: Media controls
rules.requirement: Use available overlay/inverted IconButton tones over media; light backplates need dark glyphs.
rules.cannotCheck: Rendered contrast across variable media and themes.

examples.conforming: IconButton tone="inverted" with its dark glyph
examples.nonconforming: White glyph on a white media backplate

rules.humanReview: Inspect real media, focus and both themes.

rules.title: Gradient roles
rules.requirement: Use available brand-gradient for backdrops and gradient-btn for buttons.
rules.cannotCheck: Installed utility availability, CSS descendants and visual budget.
rules.humanReview: Review scarce gradient use and descendant glyph contrast.

rules.title: Mobile targets
rules.requirement: Provide effective mobile touch bounds of at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
rules.checks: Small same-line IconButton and added a/button inferred vertical-floor warnings.
rules.cannotCheck: Width, actual layout, CSS conflicts, multiline props and unchanged opening tags.
rules.humanReview: Measure actual bounds and spacing; warnings are not enforcement.

rules.title: Keyboard focus
rules.requirement: Preserve visible focus; provide a replacement when overriding global focus.
rules.cannotCheck: Keyboard reachability, focus visibility, clipping and media contrast.
rules.humanReview: Exercise keyboard navigation and dismissal in context.

rules.title: Accessible identity and state
rules.requirement: Name icon-only controls and expose matching selected/pressed states.
rules.cannotCheck: Accessible tree, label-in-name, dynamic announcements and actual behavior.
rules.humanReview: Check rendered names; preserve visible labels and control identity when adding reasons.
